اختلبن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَبْنَ (iḵtalabna) /ix.ta.lab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)

# اِخْتَلِبْنَ (iḵtalibna) /ix.ta.lib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
